research_model: iPSC Microglia Cohorts + Post-mortem Brain Tissues
framework: Ziff et al. 2023 (ALS) + Scheidemantel et al. 2026 (AD)

pathway_benchmarks.methods: GSEA Hallmark (PM), decoupleR PROGENy (iPSC), DoRoTHEa v3 (PM)

key_biological_findings: p53/DDR activation is the strongest cross-system signal (NES = 3.2 iPSC, 6.2 PM)
SPI1, CEBPB, TP53 identified as top activated TFs (DoRoTHEa v3)
Intron retention significantly increased in AD (consistent with TDP-43 pathology)
Somatic mutation burden and gene fusions elevated in AD microglia (P < 1e-4)
APOE4/fAD subgroups converge on shared downstream mechanisms (r = 0.85)
validation_strategy: Ground truth benchmarking against published AD literature
output_format: 23 publication-ready PDF figures + R Markdown report
